name: Docs drift collector
objective: Find documentation that no longer matches code, tests, CLI behavior, API schemas, screenshots, or examples, then propose small verified patches.

trigger.cadence_or_event: Weekly, and after release branches, CLI flag changes, public API changes, or docs-related issues.

intake.selection_rule: Patch only drift confirmed against code, schema, tests, or runtime output.

agents.responsibility: Map changed behavior to docs that mention it.
Run docs tests, examples, link checks, or CLI comparisons.

gates: updated examples run or match current output
diff is scoped to confirmed drift

state.update_rule: Record candidate drift items, checked files, accepted patches, rejected false positives, and verification commands.

escalation.destination: docs owner issue or PR comment

exit.success: All high-confidence drift items are patched and verified.
exit.stop_without_success: Remaining items require owner judgment or verification cannot run.
